Transaction DAG dispatch and block staging APIs for replay scheduling.

# Purpose
`fd_rdisp.h` defines the public interface for a replay dispatcher that builds dependency order for transactions and schedules them with parallel execution when possible. It manages transaction indices instead of storing full transactions, and it tracks each index through states such as `FREE`, `PENDING`, `READY`, `DISPATCHED`, and `ZOMBIE`. The file also defines block management for staged and unstaged blocks, staging lanes, and functions to add, remove, promote, demote, rekey, and abandon blocks. It provides the API for inserting transactions, selecting the next ready transaction, completing execution, inspecting staging lane state, and verifying internal consistency.
